description: Use this when the user asks what is trending, popular, hot or most traded on Polymarket or in prediction markets right now, or wants an overview of the biggest open markets in a category — for example "what's trending on Polymarket", "most popular prediction markets today", "top crypto markets right now", or "what are people trading on in politics". Returns up to 20 open Polymarket.com events with the most trading volume in the last 24 hours, each with up to four outcomes' market-implied probabilities (the leaders, or a price ladder's rungs nearest 50%), 24-hour change and volume. Optional category filter. Events that look settled (an outcome at 99% or more) and games' secondary prop sheets are left out. Excludes individual sports and esports games (single matches, live or upcoming) unless the category is sports or esports; futures such as a season or championship winner stay in. Mature topics, and without a category "Up or Down" and tweet-count markets, are also left out. Read-only crowd forecasts, not certainties or advice. Do not use this to choose a market or trader for the user to put money in. Do not call this when the user asks which market to buy or how to make a profit.

category.description: Limit to one Polymarket category, e.g. 'politics', 'crypto', 'sports', 'economy'. Omit for all categories

name: get_trending_markets

outcomes.description: Ranked by probability for mutually exclusive outcomes; natural order for ladders

market_slug.description: Slug of the market that prices this outcome

outcomes_total.description: Total outcomes in the event; outcomes[] may be truncated

type.description: binary = one Yes/No (or two-sided) market; multi = several mutually exclusive or laddered outcomes

title: Get trending markets
